verdict.line: You lose if you eat Cannon-stance Shock Blast pokes before level 3; you win once Q (Volcanic Rupture) and E (Searing Charge) let you force a trade on his cooldowns.

brief.thesis: Jayce's threat is entirely stance-dependent: Cannon stance pokes with Q (Shock Blast) and E (Acceleration Gate) but has no melee tools, while Hammer stance commits him to leap-range melee where Ornn's Q slow and E charge punish him hard. The 55.4% head-to-head win rate over 1,737 games and Ornn's solo-kill edge both come from catching him mid-stance or right after he spends Shock Blast.

tell.watch: Jayce's stance icon, Hammer or Cannon

theirWindow.when: Cannon stance with Shock Blast off cooldown
theirWindow.what: He free-pokes with Q (Shock Blast) at 600 range through any Acceleration Gate; farm behind minions with your own Q (Volcanic Rupture) instead of walking up to trade.

yourWindow.when: Jayce swaps to Hammer stance or Q is down
yourWindow.what: Close with Q (Volcanic Rupture) for the slow, follow through with E (Searing Charge) and a point-blank W (Bellows Breath) to land Brittle before he can swap back to Cannon and run.

powerCurve.note: Cannon Shock Blast pokes freely, you have no gap closer
E online, Q+E combo punishes his all-ins
R plus jungler calls overwhelm his lack of mobility
Tank itemization and Brittle dominate extended skirmishes

start.why: 55.1% win rate over 1,414 games and 70.3% pick rate; the sustain shrugs off Cannon-stance Shock Blast chip before you have a gap closer.

boots.why: 56% win rate over 1,646 games and the 84.9% pick rate reflects how much of Jayce's early damage is auto-attacks and physical Q/E hits.

core.why: Immolate passive punishes his melee Hammer-stance engages and keeps you relevant in wave clear through the poke phase.
Part of the 56.4% win rate path over 94 games; grievous wounds and bonus armor shut down his auto-attack damage once he commits to Hammer form.
Closes out the same 56.4% core path with stacking resistances that scale as fights go long, which is where Ornn wins this matchup.

situational.when: he is building full lethality/crit and you need the omnivamp and shield proc to survive extended trades
his damage shifts more magic-heavy later (Mercury Cannon bonus magic hit) or you are facing a magic-heavy enemy comp
you need the early grievous wounds and armor spike specifically against his auto-attack reset patterns

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp rewards the slow extended trades Ornn wants against Jayce's low-sustain Cannon stance, and it scales your health into damage, matching the tank build path.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is run in 81.6% of games at 55.7% win rate; Teleport lets you reset after shoving with Sunfire Aegis and still answer top-side jungler calls that punish Jayce's lack of mobility.

playing.title: Track his stance, not his HP
playing.detail: Cannon stance means ranged poke is live; Hammer stance means he has committed to a melee trade range where you win. Decide whether to farm or engage off that icon alone.

playing.title: Farm through Cannon poke
playing.detail: Don't contest minions he's pressuring with Q (Shock Blast, 600 range); last-hit with your own Q (Volcanic Rupture) from max range and let Doran's Shield absorb the chip.

playing.title: All-in on his Q cooldown
playing.detail: Shock Blast/To the Skies! is 16/14/12/10/8s on cooldown. The moment he throws it and misses or whiffs an engage, close immediately with Q into E before he can reset.

playing.title: Save W for the Brittle lock-in
playing.detail: W (Bellows Breath)'s final gout applies Brittle; land it point-blank right before your E (Searing Charge) connects so the burst lands while he's debuffed, not after.

playing.title: Call jungler proactively
playing.detail: Jayce has zero displacement besides his Q leap; a single gank from level 2 onward near-guarantees a kill since he cannot disengage once you've landed Q's slow.

playing.title: Hold R for forced fights
playing.detail: Call of the Forge God is 140/120/100/100/100s; don't waste it poking waveclear. Save the recast knockup for exactly the moment he tries to walk away in Hammer stance.

playing.title: Respect early poke, not the matchup
playing.detail: Levels 1-2 are the only window he's ahead; once E (Searing Charge) is up at 3, the OP.GG-measured solo-kill edge is yours, so don't play scared past level 3.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers above are measured OP.GG data on the current patch (16.19.1); the stance-timing and trade-window reasoning is my own read of the kit, not sourced from that data.

stats.opponentTip: Jayce is strong during early game so try play defensively. However, he lacks movement skills, so try to kill him after a couple of [Q] pokes. He has a hard time dealing with ganks, so try to call you jungler often for support.
